method.independentReviewer: Reviewer did not author the Web feature or organization repair. Reused only own round3 same-byte reading evidence, explicitly per file.

method.fullPartitionReview: Current semantic boundary sweep covered all production components/hooks/libraries, all current test declarations and support/config/style structure. Whole user-flow review included application authentication/navigation, creation/addition and owner changes, root identity, chat execution/history/queue/goals, model/provider catalogs, tool/settings operations, files/Git/worktrees, terminal/CLI/process lifecycles, rendering/menu/mobile layout, storage and receipts. This is not merely a 2-file repair review.
method.depth: Two changed files read fully; ProjectDialog, useWorkflow, ExtensionControls and TurnFooter also freshly read fully. Selected critical Workspace/MessageItem/root/model/organization bodies were freshly revisited. Unchanged body reading depth from round3 is retained per file and is not relabeled as a fresh line-by-line review. Prior free-form body-range notes were not mechanically copied; current selected ranges are keyed by exact path.
method.execution: Only the 2 positive independent reproduction cases were executed. Author organization run 38/38 was verified from its result JSON; no full suite or fresh tsc/build/browser run by this reviewer.
method.originalEvidence: Original round3 nonclean report and defect reproduction remain byte-for-byte unchanged; preserved hashes verified again while writing this report.

semanticCoverage.result: Auto path grammar and preview/submission use the same lexical semantics, preserve POSIX literal names, gate invalid Unicode/control/JSON bytes, and retain user text/errors. Api/CSRF/epoch/mode/UID/readiness scope rejects stale defaults and old completion. Dev without managed identity remains allowed; known root identity loss remains blocked. Root equivalence repair closes the prior false metadata selection.

Server authorization/revision and explicit confirmation still required. Runtime mode changes gate writes before changing draft namespace/thread. Retained root warning and unsaved-draft admission remain independent of requested mode; no automatic escalation.

Provider-qualified catalog identity, shared runtime directory, bounded pages and stale result guards retained. Chat-specific defaults, effort/media admission, explicit resume/send/queue/steer/stop/goal/branch/revert/review routes remain distinct; acceptance cleanup retains newer drafts and unknowns are not replayed.

Only dedicated public summary fields render reasoning summaries; final-copy admission excludes raw/mixed/unfinished content. Current footer, menu expansion/escape, safe Markdown/media limits, responsive composer bounds and owner-scoped feedback revisited.

Account/OAuth/secret owner lifetimes, MCP calls/results/streams, plugin/skill/import/trust/versioned configuration, service/root controls, private pairing and recovery preserve explicit intents and fresh identity/version facts.

File drafts, metadata/version/no-replace, exact Git index/HEAD, bounded worktree confirmations, workspace owner changes, terminal/CLI/process lease and unknown receipt behavior revisited; no unrelated metadata path is selected after comparator repair.

Current storage/history/catalog/media/Markdown/terminal budgets, receipt recovery/archive proof, cancellation and stale ownership boundaries inspected. All test/support file structure checked with same-byte baseline body evidence and full new organization assertions.
